metadata.name: A1
metadata.description: label: B1 is the HUB-FORM pivot — the grid rows as a list of dicts

metadata.name: B1
metadata.description: the collections-doctrine pivot: the editable grid range → the hub form (a LIST OF DICTS keyed by the header row); everything downstream derives from THIS cell

metadata.name: A2
metadata.description: label: B2 is the species filter the dashboard's select writes

metadata.name: B2
metadata.description: the selected species ('all' = no filter) — the dashboard's <select> writes it via param.set; every chart derives through =FILTER on it

metadata.name: A3
metadata.description: label: B3 is the filtered dataset

metadata.name: B3
metadata.description: the FILTERED dataset: keep dicts whose .species matches the filter cell (or every dict when it holds 'all'); the charts broadcast .species/.lifespan/.speed/.eggs off this

metadata.name: A4
metadata.description: label: B4 grows the dashboard view pane

metadata.name: B4
metadata.description: the GENERATIVE dashboard formula: a species <select> (param.set → the filter cell) + bar/line/pie canvases, all derived from the dataset cell B1 through the filter B3, contributed to ONE '🐢 dashboard' VIEW pane — the cell keeps the visible source (value: the ⧉ token); edit data or change the filter and every chart re-renders. Each canvas is 480×300 and passes that SAME box down to its chart verb (…, 0, 0, 480, 300) so the op list is computed for the exact surface it paints on — nothing clips: every species label (incl. 'Leatherback'/'Loggerhead') and the full pie legend fit inside the box

cels.f:
=view("🐢 dashboard", dom("div",
	dom("div", style("display", "flex", "gap", ".5rem", "align-items", "center", "padding", ".3rem"),
		"species:",
		dom("select", on("change", "param.set", "turtle_charts.B2"),
			dom("option", IF(B2 = "all", attr("selected", "selected"), ""), "all"),
			MAP(B1.species, LAMBDA(s, dom("option", IF(s = B2, attr("selected", "selected"), ""), s))))),
	dom("div", style("display", "flex", "flex-wrap", "wrap", "gap", ".5rem"),
		canvas(480, 300, barchart(B3.species, B3.lifespan, 0, 0, 480, 300)),
		canvas(480, 300, linechart(B3.species, B3.speed, 0, 0, 480, 300)),
		canvas(480, 300, piechart(B3.species, B3.eggs, 0, 0, 480, 300)))))
